description: This file contains TypeScript code for loading and parsing tsconfig files, including handling of extends, references, and path resolution.

classes.name: TsConfig
classes.description: Interface defining the parts of tsconfig that are relevant for loading.

classes.name: LoadedTsConfig
classes.description: Interface representing a loaded tsconfig with resolved paths and options.

methods.name: loadTsConfig
methods.description: Main function to load a tsconfig file and its references, returning an array of LoadedTsConfig objects.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Resolves the path to a referenced config file, appending '.json' if missing and handling node_modules fallback.

methods.name: innerLoadTsConfig
methods.description: Recursively loads a tsconfig file, resolving extends and references, and caching results.

methods.name: StripBom
methods.description: Removes BOM characters from a string if present.
